rationale: All four lenses and the standards audit ran with no truncation and a non-oversized diff; reading the four routers, the four new models modules, the services and the handler showed no missing or unused imports and no import cycle, so all 12 blind-lens concerns were dismissed. Two standards items (Optional[X] over `X | None` in the new modules, and the missing return annotation at models/project.py:218) were deferred as verbatim moves that the move-only task forbids altering, and are listed in code-review-deferred.md. Confidence is medium because the repo-wide stale-importer sweep rests on the acceptance lens's grep and other repos were not searched, and Stage 7 still owns guard tests, fresh-interpreter imports, make ruff and the test suites.
